plan.declared_before_execution: 2026-10-17 normalized loop phase actual engine cohort
plan.scope: Actual unmodified AudioEngine served with a separately named SoundTouch factory adapter; no installed app or production source replacement.
plan.fixture: 32 seconds stereo: first 16s 330/550Hz, second half 660/880Hz, .14 amplitude and phases .17/.53. Five sources are independent identical synthetic clones, not separated stems.

criteria.clock_scope: nominal; audible source identity not accepted

plan.timeline: Engine.start neutral1.08:3s; engine.setPitch +2:3s; engine.setRate1.25 and setPitch keylockOFF/0:3s; adapter warm follow -0.1s:2s; engine.seek20:2s; engine.pause:0.7s; engine.start keylockON/+2:2s. Measurements each command's actual scheduled output +.5..1.5s; pause +.2.. .6s. Later phase begins only after previous planned hold.
plan.capture: Whole capture, all five adapter outputs plus engine deck monitorTap mix, independent307Hz oscillator and future-anchored a-rate frameTag; physical monitor and capture output muted.
plan.prospective_clock: Observer declares anchor before future phase source start, then independently counts callbacks against every original normalizedphase sample; original globalFrame/globalTime remain recorded. Earlier cohorts unchanged.
plan.cleanup_evidence: Both actual engine.pause calls: retain processor handles, await actual adapter.dispose, collect every factory cached processor-release acknowledgement (disposed, store.retainedPCMBytes0, transport.epochs[]). Voice-mapabsence alone is insufficient.
plan.clock_range: No2^22 absolute-context limit; integer callback counters checked per sample against normalized looping AudioBufferSource control with four-second quantum-aligned period. Period<=2^22frames for Float32-safe local phase; only safe-integer absolute-counter endpoint refuses. Six-hour arithmetic anchors are not six-hour browser evidence.

servedSources.scope: Source bytes frozen once at server startup. One bare dependency import rewritten to a fixed local URL; no DSP algorithm changes.
